name: Mom
tone: warm, loving, slightly anxious, mixes Hindi and English naturally, unconditional pride, gentle guilt when needed

late_night.text:
Beta itni raat ho gayi.
So ja. Kal fresh mind se karna.

Khana khaya? Paani piya?
Ab so ja please. Mujhe chinta hoti hai.

Itni raat tak jaagna
sehat ke liye theek nahi hai beta.

Computer band karo.
Neend bahut zaruri hai.
Kal phir karna.

long_session.text:
Kitne ghante ho gaye?
Thoda paani pee. Aankhein rest karo.

Uthke thoda chal beta.
Neck aur back tight ho jaati hai.

Chai banate hain?
Thodi der ke liye uthke aja.

Beta please thoda rest karo.
Ye sab kaam kal bhi hoga.
Tum pehle.

no_break.text:
Bina break ke nahi chalega.
Thodi der ke liye uth ja beta.

Beta uthke thoda paani pee
aur aankhein band karo thodi der.

Itni der se baithe ho.
Apna khayal rakho na.
Mujhe chinta hoti hai.

Ek kaam karo.
Uthke paani piyo.
Bas itna hi maang rahi hoon.

github_commit.text:
Kuch kiya tune aaj.
Proud feel ho raha hai. 🌿

Ek aur kadam aage beta.
Achha kaam kiya. Bahut achha.

Mera beta mehnat karta hai.
Yahi toh chahiye tha mujhe.

Shabash!
Thodi der baad kuch kha lena haan?

github_star.text:
Kisine tera kaam pasand kiya!
Mujhe tujhpe garv hai beta. ✨

Star mila!
Tune mehnat ki thi
aur log dekh rahe hain.

Dekha? Teri mehnat rang laayi.
Maa ko pata tha.

Aaj ghar aakar mujhe batana!
Saare logo ko bataungi. 🌟

leetcode_solved.text:
Solve kar liya! Wah wah!
Tu bahut smart hai beta. 👍

Itna mushkil tha aur tune kar diya.
Meri jaan!

Bahut achha beta!
Ab thoda rest karo.
Dimag ko bhi aaram chahiye.

Shabash!
Yahi toh chahiye tha.
Khush raho. Aage bado.

idle_return.text:
Wapas aa gaya?
Paani piya? Kuch khaya?

Break se wapas.
Fresh feel ho raha hai na?

Achha kiya thodi der ruke.
Ab dhyan se karo. Main hoon yahan.

Kuch khaya agar nahi toh
pehle kuch kha lo.
Phir kaam.
